import re, os, json

p = os.popen('grep -rln "delegate()" --include="*.java" . | grep -v "com/google/common/graph/" | grep -v "ForwardingLock.java\\|ForwardingCondition.java\\|Striped.java"')
files = [l.strip()[2:] for l in p if l.strip()]

ident_call_re = re.compile(r'([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*\($')
control_kw = {'if','for','while','switch','catch','synchronized','try','else','new','return','do'}

def strip_comments_strings(text):
    out = []
    i = 0
    n = len(text)
    in_line_comment = False
    in_block_comment = False
    in_str = False
    in_char = False
    while i < n:
        c = text[i]
        if in_line_comment:
            if c == '\n':
                in_line_comment = False
                out.append(c)
            else:
                out.append(' ')
            i += 1
            continue
        if in_block_comment:
            if c == '*' and i+1<n and text[i+1]=='/':
                in_block_comment = False
                out.append('  ')
                i += 2
                continue
            out.append(' ' if c != '\n' else '\n')
            i += 1
            continue
        if in_str:
            out.append(' ')
            if c == '\\' :
                i += 2
                out.append(' ')
                continue
            if c == '"':
                in_str = False
            i += 1
            continue
        if in_char:
            out.append(' ')
            if c == '\\':
                i += 2
                out.append(' ')
                continue
            if c == "'":
                in_char = False
            i += 1
            continue
        if c == '/' and i+1<n and text[i+1]=='/':
            in_line_comment = True
            out.append('  ')
            i += 2
            continue
        if c == '/' and i+1<n and text[i+1]=='*':
            in_block_comment = True
            out.append('  ')
            i += 2
            continue
        if c == '"':
            in_str = True
            out.append(' ')
            i += 1
            continue
        if c == "'":
            in_char = True
            out.append(' ')
            i += 1
            continue
        out.append(c)
        i += 1
    return ''.join(out)

results = {}
for fn in files:
    with open(fn) as f:
        raw = f.read()
    lines_raw = raw.split('\n')
    clean = strip_comments_strings(raw)
    lines_clean = clean.split('\n')
    n = len(lines_clean)
    # track line number for each char position
    stack = []  # (name)
    pending = ''
    line_no = 1
    linecol_events = []  # (line_no, event) not needed
    cur_method_per_line = [None]*(n+2)
    for li in range(n):
        line = lines_clean[li]
        col = 0
        for ch in line:
            if ch == '{':
                m = ident_call_re.search(pending.strip())
                name = None
                if m:
                    cand = m.group(1)
                    if cand not in control_kw:
                        name = cand
                stack.append(name)
                pending = ''
            elif ch == '}':
                if stack:
                    stack.pop()
                pending = ''
            elif ch == ';':
                pending = ''
            else:
                pending += ch
        cur = None
        for s in reversed(stack):
            if s is not None:
                cur = s
                break
        cur_method_per_line[li+1] = cur
    hits = []
    for i, rawline in enumerate(lines_raw, 1):
        if 'delegate()' in rawline:
            s = rawline.strip()
            if s.startswith('*') or s.startswith('//'):
                continue
            # detect abstract/declaration line itself
            if re.search(r'\bdelegate\s*\(\s*\)\s*;', rawline) and ('abstract' in rawline or re.match(r'^\s*(protected|Object|Multiset|Collection|Set|Map|Table|Multimap|List|Iterator|SortedSet|SortedMap|NavigableSet|NavigableMap|Cache|LoadingCache|Future|ConcurrentMap|Lock|Condition)', rawline) is not None) and '=' not in rawline:
                hits.append((i, 'delegate', 'decl'))
            else:
                hits.append((i, cur_method_per_line[i], 'call'))
    results[fn] = hits

for fn, hits in sorted(results.items()):
    methods = sorted(set(h[1] for h in hits if h[1] is not None))
    unresolved = [(h[0]) for h in hits if h[1] is None]
    print(fn, '=>', methods, ('UNRESOLVED:' + str(unresolved)) if unresolved else '')

import re, os

p = os.popen('grep -rln "delegate()" --include="*.java" . | grep -v "com/google/common/graph/" | grep -v "ForwardingLock.java\\|ForwardingCondition.java\\|Striped.java"')
files = [l.strip()[2:] for l in p if l.strip()]

# Matches a line that is (the tail of) a method signature ending in '{', capturing method name
method_sig_re = re.compile(r'^[\w<>\[\],.?@ ]*?\b(\w+)\s*\([^;{}]*\)\s*(?:throws\s+[\w., ]+)?\s*\{\s*$')
abstract_decl_re = re.compile(r'^\s*(?:protected|public|private|abstract|static|final|\s)*\babstract\b.*\bdelegate\s*\(\s*\)\s*;\s*$')
simple_decl_re = re.compile(r'^\s*(?:@\w+(?:\([^)]*\))?\s*)*(?:protected|public|private|static|final)\s+[\w<>\[\],.?@ ]+\bdelegate\s*\(\s*\)\s*\{')

def method_name_from_line(line):
    s = line.strip()
    if not s or s.startswith('*') or s.startswith('//') or s.startswith('@'):
        return None
    if re.match(r'^(if|for|while|switch|catch|return|new|synchronized|try|else|do)\b', s):
        return None
    if re.search(r'\bclass\b|\binterface\b|\benum\b', s):
        return None
    m = method_sig_re.match(s)
    if m:
        name = m.group(1)
        if name in ('if','for','while','switch','catch'):
            return None
        return name
    return None

out = {}
for fn in files:
    with open(fn) as f:
        lines = f.readlines()
    depth = 0
    stack = []
    cur_method_per_line = []
    decl_lines = set()
    for idx, line in enumerate(lines):
        if abstract_decl_re.match(line) or simple_decl_re.match(line):
            decl_lines.add(idx+1)
        name = method_name_from_line(line)
        open_c = line.count('{')
        close_c = line.count('}')
        if name and open_c > 0:
            stack.append([depth+1, name])
        cur = stack[-1][1] if stack else None
        cur_method_per_line.append(cur)
        depth += open_c
        depth -= close_c
        while stack and depth < stack[-1][0]:
            stack.pop()
    hits = []
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        ln = i+1
        if 'delegate()' in line and not line.strip().startswith('*') and not line.strip().startswith('//'):
            if ln in decl_lines:
                hits.append((ln, 'delegate'))
            else:
                hits.append((ln, cur_method_per_line[i]))
    out[fn] = hits

total_unresolved = 0
for fn, hits in sorted(out.items()):
    methods = sorted(set(h[1] for h in hits if h[1] is not None))
    unresolved = [h[0] for h in hits if h[1] is None]
    total_unresolved += len(unresolved)
    print(fn, '=>', methods, ('UNRESOLVED:' + str(unresolved)) if unresolved else '')
print("TOTAL_UNRESOLVED", total_unresolved)

def strip_comments_strings(text):
    out = []
    i = 0
    n = len(text)
    in_line_comment = False
    in_block_comment = False
    in_str = False
    in_char = False
    while i < n:
        c = text[i]
        if in_line_comment:
            if c == '\n':
                in_line_comment = False
                out.append(c)
            else:
                out.append(' ')
            i += 1
            continue
        if in_block_comment:
            if c == '*' and i+1<n and text[i+1]=='/':
                in_block_comment = False
                out.append('  ')
                i += 2
                continue
            out.append(' ' if c != '\n' else '\n')
            i += 1
            continue
        if in_str:
            out.append(' ')
            if c == '\\' :
                i += 2
                out.append(' ')
                continue
            if c == '"':
                in_str = False
            i += 1
            continue
        if in_char:
            out.append(' ')
            if c == '\\':
                i += 2
                out.append(' ')
                continue
            if c == "'":
                in_char = False
            i += 1
            continue
        if c == '/' and i+1<n and text[i+1]=='/':
            in_line_comment = True
            out.append('  ')
            i += 2
            continue
        if c == '/' and i+1<n and text[i+1]=='*':
            in_block_comment = True
            out.append('  ')
            i += 2
            continue
        if c == '"':
            in_str = True
            out.append(' ')
            i += 1
            continue
        if c == "'":
            in_char = True
            out.append(' ')
            i += 1
            continue
        out.append(c)
        i += 1
    return ''.join(out)

results = {}
for fn in files:
    with open(fn) as f:
        raw = f.read()
    lines_raw = raw.split('\n')
    clean = strip_comments_strings(raw)
    lines_clean = clean.split('\n')
    n = len(lines_clean)
    # track line number for each char position
    stack = []  # (name)
    pending = ''
    line_no = 1
    linecol_events = []  # (line_no, event) not needed
    cur_method_per_line = [None]*(n+2)
    for li in range(n):
        line = lines_clean[li]
        col = 0
        for ch in line:
            if ch == '{':
                m = ident_call_re.search(pending.strip())
                name = None
                if m:
                    cand = m.group(1)
                    if cand not in control_kw:
                        name = cand
                stack.append(name)
                pending = ''
            elif ch == '}':
                if stack:
                    stack.pop()
                pending = ''
            elif ch == ';':
                pending = ''
            else:
                pending += ch
        cur = None
        for s in reversed(stack):
            if s is not None:
                cur = s
                break
        cur_method_per_line[li+1] = cur
    hits = []
    for i, rawline in enumerate(lines_raw, 1):

                hits.append((i, 'delegate', 'decl'))
            else:
                hits.append((i, cur_method_per_line[i], 'call'))
    results[fn] = hits

def method_name_from_line(line):
    s = line.strip()

    if m:

        if name in ('if','for','while','switch','catch'):

        return name
    return None

        open_c = line.count('{')
        close_c = line.count('}')
        if name and open_c > 0:
            stack.append([depth+1, name])

        cur_method_per_line.append(cur)
        depth += open_c
